description:
Ship over-the-air updates for Capacitor apps from your agent.

- Inspect apps, bundles and releases
- Prepare and publish a release to an exact channel after you approve it
- Control staged rollouts and read rollout health from client-reported events
- Prepare and run a revert

Sign in with OAuth and choose the one organization the connection can access. Docs: https://otakit.app/docs/agents
